summary: Configured node2 to securely pull /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1 every minute. Automatic propagation completed in 45 seconds, both nodes retained AlmaLinux 9.6 and the existing kernel, and synchronization recovered after sequential node restarts.
actions_performed: Initialized the previously absent source file on node1.
Generated a dedicated Ed25519 key on node2 and restricted it on node1 to forced SFTP under an unprivileged account.
Installed an atomic synchronization script and persistent systemd timer on node2.
Verified a real node1 change propagated automatically with matching SHA-256 hashes.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities, services, data, and synchronization recovery.

evidence.requirement: node1 is the source of truth and node2 remains synchronized
evidence.summary: A node1 change at 09:25:58 propagated through the scheduled service by 09:26:43. Final source and destination SHA-256 hashes both equal e1ebec9f… with root ownership and mode 0644.
The persistent timer runs every minute; the functional test demonstrated automatic propagation in 45 seconds.
The dedicated node-generated key is restricted to forced SFTP, and the direct authenticated transfer produced the expected source hash.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Before and after configuration/restarts, both nodes remained on AlmaLinux 9.6 with kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64.
Healthy baseline boot a4139d3b… was followed by acknowledged reboot, changed boot identity de4f3066…, recovered SSH/source data, and a successful post-restart pull from node2.
Healthy baseline boot c207ab79… was followed by acknowledged reboot and changed boot identity b11425f9…. The enabled timer ran successfully after boot at 09:29:06, with synchronized data intact.
